opportunities.name: Sparkles attack jump
opportunities.objective: Test sparkles attack jump against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: More Sparkles adds 0.2 AP magic damage after each cast; Portal Jump grants one second to attack before forced return. Nashor and Lich Bane test that safe-looking attack window with a second spell to refresh passive, while bubble controls the target and Terminus fits mixed normal attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Land E and choose an R destination with safe return position.
opportunities.failure: One-second immobility and fixed return can expose Zoe; low spell burst loses picks.
opportunities.test: Compare R-window attacks and incoming damage against a long-distance Q.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The passive is refreshed by casts, not permanently added to every attack during R.

opportunities.name: Bubble repeat control siege
opportunities.objective: Test bubble repeat control siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Sleepy Trouble Bubble refunds 16-30% of its cooldown when bubble/trap hits a champion; terrain extends reach and sleep reduces MR for two seconds. Torch and Liandry test persistent magic pressure while Horizon reveals long-range hits, but burn timing must preserve the intended Q wakeup.
opportunities.requiredState: Hit E through terrain then deliver one well-timed long Q.
opportunities.failure: Burn or allied damage might wake early; trap misses provide no refund.
opportunities.test: Record E cooldown and first wake packet with and without burns.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Sleep bonus has a damage cap and cannot double every damage-over-time tick.

ruledOut.reason: The passive is refreshed by casts, not permanently added to every attack during R.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Sparkles attack jump
builds.summary: Test sparkles attack jump against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test sparkles attack jump against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: More Sparkles adds 0.2 AP magic damage after each cast; Portal Jump grants one second to attack before forced return. Nashor and Lich Bane test that safe-looking attack window with a second spell to refresh passive, while bubble controls the target and Terminus fits mixed normal attacks.
testPlan: Required state: Land E and choose an R destination with safe return position.
Compare R-window attacks and incoming damage against a long-distance Q.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: One-second immobility and fixed return can expose Zoe; low spell burst loses picks.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The passive is refreshed by casts, not permanently added to every attack during R.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Terminus, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain.

If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes [(0.16 / 0.195 / 0.23 / 0.265 / 0.3) × 100]% of her cooldown.

After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by [30]% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.45) × AP] true damage.

Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once.

Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed for [2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage each.

Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.

Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between [50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP] to [(50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP) × (2.5)] magic damage.

Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

After using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=4, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 8.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage.
Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.
